topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't help but hold onto this teddy bear a little tighter as I continue walking, my steps growing slower. The colors are faded, the fur worn thin, but it's unmistakably mine. I remember the countless nights this bear was my only company, the way it would sit by my bed, silent yet comforting. Finding it here, amidst a stranger’s old things, feels like uncovering a piece of my past I thought was long lost. The world has moved on, yet here is a familiar friend, waiting for me in the most unexpected place. I wonder if it remembers the stories I told, the dreams I shared. Maybe, just maybe, I can give it a new chapter, a new home.
